read_by: Script scan of the council's own PDFs plus the author's reading of the page text above each clause, 2026-11-09. NOT an owner read.
method: For each council, the rank-1 clause shown for a dwelling house in zone group R2 for 6 topics (front, side, rear setback; car parking; landscaping; private open space). The council's own PDF is opened at the cited page and the section heading path above the clause is read. red = the clause sits under a heading or page for another building type, a specific neighbourhood or site (dual occupancy, semi-detached, multi-dwelling, narrow lot, estate, precinct, outbuildings, basement, suburb profile); green = under a heading for houses; none = a general heading.
how_named: A council is named when none of its first rules is under a heading for another building type or a site AND its top-5 recall on the proven rules is at least 80% (live rows).

not_named.georges_river: 2 first rules wrong: 6.1.4 Narrow Lot Housing - Bellevue Estate (rear setback); 6.1.3 Dual Occupancy (private open space)
not_named.ashfield: 1 first rule wrong: Part 4 Residential Multi dwelling housing (rear setback)
not_named.leichhardt: 2 first rules area-specific: C2.2.2.5 neighbourhood setback (front); George & Upward Streets precinct chapter (landscaping)
not_named.cumberland: 2 first rules wrong type: basement wall clause (side setback); 2.20 Outbuildings (rear setback)
not_named.blacktown: 1 first rule under a heading for another building type or site (scan_all)
not_named.parramatta: 1 first rule under such a heading (scan_all)
not_named.northern_beaches: 1 first rule under such a heading (scan_all)
not_named.canterbury_bankstown: all 6 first rules are from site-specific chapters 11.6 Potts Hill and 11.13 Former WSU Campus Milperra
not_named.hornsby: failed the one cheap fix round 2026-11-09 (leak removal cut hold-out recall from 94% to 80%)

limits: A none flag means no heading contradicts the rule, not that it is verified right. Ranks 2 and 3 are not read here. With 4 clean councils there are 23 rows; the sign-off bar of at least 30 rows across at least 5 councils is NOT met, and has not been weakened.
